sections.title: Grammar: Personal Pronouns & Possessive Adjectives
sections.titleUz: Grammatika: shaxs olmoshlari va egalik sifatlari

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida bitta shaxs uchun UCH XIL shakl bor.
Har biri gapda boshqa vazifani bajaradi.

  EGA        OBYEKT     EGALIK SIFATI
  (fe'ldan   (fe'ldan   (otdan
   oldin)     keyin)     oldin)
  ─────────────────────────────────
  I          me         my
  you        you        your
  he         him        his
  she        her        her
  it         it         its
  we         us         our
  you        you        your
  they       them       their

MISOLLAR — bitta shaxs, uch shakl:
  SHE is my aunt.        (ega)
  Look at HER.           (obyekt)
  HER husband is Peter.  (egalik sifati)

O'ZBEKCHA BILAN SOLISHTIRISH:
  u        → he/she
  uni/unga → him/her
  uning    → his/her
rule.warningUz:
ENG CHALKASH JUFTLIKLAR:

  HER ikki vazifada ishlatiladi:
    Look at HER.       — obyekt (unga)
    HER husband        — egalik sifati (uning eri)

  HIS ham ikki vazifada:
    HIS car            — egalik sifati (uning mashinasi)
    The car is HIS.    — egalik olmoshi (uniki)

  ITS va IT'S — MUTLAQO boshqa:
    ITS name is Rex.   — uning ismi (egalik, apostrof YO'Q)
    IT'S a dog.        — u it (it is ning qisqasi)

  THEIR / THERE / THEY'RE — bir xil eshitiladi, boshqa ma'no:
    THEIR son  — ularning o'g'li (egalik)
    THERE is   — bor (Unit 3)
    THEY'RE    — ular ...dir (they are)
rule.noteUz:
EGALIK SIFATIDAN KEYIN ARTIKL QO'YILMAYDI:
  ✅ my book        ❌ my the book
  ✅ their parents  ❌ the their parents

Va egalik sifati OT bilan birga keladi — yolg'iz turmaydi:
  ✅ This is my book.
  ❌ This is my.   (to'g'risi: This is mine.)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in her, me, him, my or their.
exercises.instructionUz: her, me, him, my yoki their — jadvaldagi bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi jadvalda beshta bo'sh joy bor:

  Subject Pronouns:     I, you, he, she, it, we, you, they  (to'liq)
  Object Pronouns:      __, you, __, her, it, us, you, them
  Possessive Adjectives: __, your, his, __, its, our, your, __

Har bir ustun BITTA shaxsga tegishli — yuqoridan pastga qarang.

items.whyUz: 4-ustun. HER husband — uning eri. DIQQAT: obyekt shakli ham 'her'.

exercises.instructionUz: Butun jadvalni to'ldiring — bu Unit 4 ning asosiy grammatikasi.
exercises.explanationUz: Jadvalni to'liq yodlab olish shart. U butun kitob davomida kerak bo'ladi.

items.whyUz: Look at it. Its name. DIQQAT: 'its' da apostrof YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and underline the examples of the possessive case and the possessive adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va egalik shakllari hamda egalik sifatlarini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
LIZANING OILA DARAXTI (family tree):

              Bill  &  Carol          (bobo va buvi)
                 │        │
        ┌────────┴───┬────┴────────┐
      John + Ann   Helen + Peter
        │             │
      Lisa (7)      Dave (5)

  Bill va Carol — John va Helenning ota-onasi
  John — Lizaning otasi, Ann — onasi
  Helen — Johnning singlisi, Lizaning ammasi
  Peter — Helenning eri, Lizaning pochchasi (uncle)
  Dave — Helen va Peterning o'g'li, Lizaning amakivachchasi

MATNDA IKKI XIL EGALIK BOR — ularni ajratib oling:

  EGALIK SHAKLI ('s bilan yasalgan):
    my father'S sister, Their son'S name, John and Helen'S parents

  EGALIK SIFATLARI (my, your, his, her, its, our, their):
    MY parents, MY father's, MY aunt, HER husband,
    MY uncle, THEIR son's, MY cousin, OUR grandparents

sentences.en: Hi! I'm Lisa and I'm seven.
sentences.uz: Salom! Men Lizaman va yetti yoshdaman.

sentences.en: John and Ann are my parents.

sentences.noteUz: IKKALASI ham bor: MY (egalik sifati) + father'S (egalik shakli).
EGALIK SIFATI: her ('uning' — Helenning). 'her' bu yerda obyekt emas!
EGALIK SIFATI: my. Ammaning eri ham 'uncle'.
IKKALASI: THEIR (egalik sifati) + son'S (egalik shakli). Ikki bosqichli egalik!
EGALIK SIFATI: my. 'cousin' — amakivachcha, xolavachcha, jiyan — hammasi bitta so'z.

sentences.en: Bill and Carol are our grandparents.
sentences.uz: Bill va Kerol — bizning bobo va buvimiz.
sentences.noteUz: EGALIK SIFATI: our ('bizning' — Liza va Deyvning).

sentences.en: They are John and Helen's parents.
sentences.noteUz: EGALIK SHAKLI: John and Helen'S — ikki egasi, 's faqat oxirgisiga.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the family tree in Ex. 10 and complete the sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: 10-mashqdagi oila daraxtiga qarang va gaplarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir bandda IKKI xil javob kerak:
  1-bo'shliq — EGALIK SHAKLI (ism + 's)
  2-bo'shliq — EGALIK SIFATI (his, her, their...)

NAMUNA:
  Dave is JOHN AND ANN'S nephew. He is THEIR nephew.
     ↑ egalik shakli              ↑ egalik sifati

Ikkinchi gap birinchisining QISQARTIRILGAN varianti —
ism o'rniga olmosh keladi.

QARINDOSHLIK ESLATMASI:
  nephew — jiyan (o'g'il)     niece  — jiyan (qiz)
  cousin — amakivachcha       aunt   — amma, xola
  uncle  — amaki, pochcha     wife   — xotin
  husband — er

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Deyv — Jon va Annning jiyani.
Kitobdagi namuna. John and Ann → they → their.
Liza — Deyvning amakivachchasi (Deyv Helen va Piterning o'g'li).
Liza — Helen va Piterning jiyani (qiz), chunki Helen Lizaning otasining singlisi.
Matnda: 'Peter is her husband' — demak Helen Piterning xotini.
Ann — Jonning xotini, Jon esa Helenning akasi. Demak Ann Deyvning ammasi.
Oila daraxtining tepasida: Bill & Carol — er-xotin.

rule.titleUz: Who's va Whose — bir xil eshitiladi, boshqa ma'no
rule.explanationUz:
Bu ikki so'z BIR XIL o'qiladi: /huːz/.
Lekin ma'nosi butunlay boshqa.

  WHO'S  = WHO IS  → 'kim?'
           Who's Lisa?  — Liza kim?

  WHOSE  = 'kimning?' → EGASINI so'raydi
           Whose is this ball?  — Bu to'p kimniki?
           Whose dog is it?     — Bu it kimning iti?

QANDAY AJRATISH:
  • 'is' ni qo'yib ko'ring: 'Who is Lisa?' — mantiqli → WHO'S
  • Keyin OT kelsami? → WHOSE (Whose DOG, Whose HOUSE)
  • Javob ODAM bo'lsa → Who's
  • Javob EGALIK ('s bilan) bo'lsa → Whose

rules.uzRule: Who's ...? = Who is ...? — odamning kimligini so'raydi.

rules.enRule: Whose ...? is used to ask who the possessor is.
examples: Whose house is it? — It's Steven's.

rule.warningUz:
APOSTROF hal qiluvchi:
  WHO'S — apostrof BOR = who is
  WHOSE — apostrof YO'Q = kimning

Bu 'it's / its' juftligiga o'xshaydi:
  it's = it is (apostrof bor)
  its  = uning (apostrof yo'q)

QOIDA: apostrof HAR DOIM tushib qolgan harf o'rnida turadi.
Egalik olmoshlarida (its, whose, hers, ours, theirs) apostrof YO'Q.
rule.noteUz:
JAVOB SHAKLLARI:
  Whose dog is it? — Lyn's.        (qisqa: faqat ism + 's)
                   — It's Lyn's dog. (to'liq)

  Whose house is it? — It's Steven's.

Qisqa javobda ot takrorlanmaydi — faqat ega qoladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in who's, whose, him, them, her or me.
exercises.instructionUz: who's, whose, him, them, her yoki me — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH SO'Z:

  SAVOL so'zlari: who's (kim?), whose (kimning?)
  OBYEKT olmoshlari: him, them, her, me

QANDAY TANLASH:
  • gap savol bo'lsa va ODAM so'ralsa → who's
  • gap savol bo'lsa va EGASI so'ralsa (keyin ot kelsa) → whose
  • fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin bo'lsa → obyekt olmoshi

Javobga ham qarang — u ko'p narsani aytadi.

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Keyin ot ('dog') keladi va javob egalik ('Lyn's') — demak Whose.
Javob 'She's ...' — odamning kimligi aytilyapti. Who is Lisa?
Keyin ot ('niece') keladi va javob egalik — Whose.
Javob ISM ('John') — odam so'ralgan. Who is Sally's brother?
'Help' fe'lidan keyin obyekt olmoshi. Gapiruvchi o'ziga yordam so'rayapti → me.
Keyingi gapda 'HE can help you' — demak erkak → him.
Keyingi gapda 'THEY'RE very tall' — ko'plik → them.
'It's HERS' — ayolniki, demak → her. 'to' predlogidan keyin obyekt shakli.
Javob 'He's ...' — odamning kimligi. Who is James?

exercises.instructionEn: Look at Lisa's family tree. Ask and answer questions with who's or whose.
exercises.instructionUz: Lizaning oila daraxtiga qarang. who's yoki whose bilan savol berib, javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA — uch kishilik zanjir:
  S1: Who's Dave?
  S2: He's Lisa's cousin. Whose son is John?
  S3: He's Carol and Bill's son.

Har bir o'quvchi javob berib, KEYINGI savolni beradi.
Shunda suhbat uzluksiz davom etadi.

OILA DARAXTI:
  Bill & Carol → John va Helen (ularning farzandlari)
  John + Ann → Lisa
  Helen + Peter → Dave

items.question: Who's Helen?
items.answer: She's Lisa's aunt and John's sister.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'Helen is my father's sister. She is my aunt.'

items.question: Who's Peter?
items.answer: He's Helen's husband and Lisa's uncle.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'Peter is her husband. He's my uncle.'

items.question: Who's Ann?
items.answer: She's Lisa's mother and John's wife.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'John and Ann are my parents.'

items.question: Who are Bill and Carol?
items.whyUz: Ko'plik uchun 'Who ARE ...?'. Matnda: 'Bill and Carol are our grandparents.'

exercises.instructionEn: Point to students and objects in your classroom and make sentences using object pronouns.
exercises.instructionUz: Sinfingizdagi o'quvchilar va narsalarni ko'rsatib, obyekt olmoshlari bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA:
  S1: Look at them. They're desks.
  S2: Look at her. She's Mary.

QOLIP: Look at + OBYEKT olmoshi. + EGA olmoshi + is/are + kim/nima.

OLMOSHNI TANLASH:
  bitta erkak/o'g'il → him ... He's ...
  bitta ayol/qiz     → her ... She's ...
  bitta narsa        → it  ... It's ...
  bir nechta         → them ... They're ...

DIQQAT: birinchi gapda OBYEKT shakli (him/her/it/them),
ikkinchi gapda EGA shakli (he/she/it/they).

modelSentences.sentence: Look at it. It's a blackboard.
Look at it. It's a window.

exercises.instructionEn: Write on the board some of your relatives' names (e.g. Tony, Paula, Tom, Philip, Kathy). The class in two teams, try to guess who each person is, as in the example. The teams win one point for each correct guess. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Doskaga qarindoshlaringizning ismlarini yozing. Sinf ikki jamoaga bo'linib, har bir odam kimligini topishga harakat qiladi. Har bir to'g'ri javob 1 ochko.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'YIN QOIDASI:
  1) Siz doskaga 5 ta qarindoshingiz ismini yozasiz
  2) Jamoalar navbat bilan HA/YO'Q savoli beradi
  3) Siz faqat 'Yes, he is' yoki 'No, he isn't' deb javob berasiz
  4) To'g'ri topsa — jamoaga 1 ochko

NAMUNA:
  Team A S1: Is Tony your father?    You: No, he isn't.
  Team B S1: Is he your uncle?       You: Yes, he is.

QOLIP:
  Is + ISM + your + qarindoshlik?
  Is he/she your + qarindoshlik?

QISQA JAVOB:
  Yes, he is.  /  No, he isn't.
  Yes, she is. /  No, she isn't.

DIQQAT: qisqa javobda ot takrorlanmaydi.
  ✅ Yes, he is.
  ❌ Yes, he is my uncle. (bu to'liq javob, o'yin uchun uzun)

exercises.instructionEn: Draw your family tree and write a short text like the one in Ex. 10. Decorate your project with pictures of your family.
exercises.instructionUz: O'z oila daraxtingizni chizing va 10-mashqdagiga o'xshash qisqa matn yozing. Loyihani oila rasmlari bilan bezang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OILA DARAXTI CHIZISH:
  • eng tepada — bobo va buvi
  • o'rtada — ota-ona va ularning aka-uka, opa-singillari
  • pastda — siz va amakivachchalaringiz

MATN TARTIBI (10-mashqdagi kabi):
  1) O'zingizni tanishtiring: Hi! I'm ... and I'm ...
  2) Ota-onangiz: ... are my parents.
  3) Amma/amaki: ... is my father's sister. She is my aunt.
  4) Ularning turmush o'rtog'i: ... is her husband. He's my uncle.
  5) Amakivachchangiz: Their son's/daughter's name is ...
  6) Bobo-buvingiz: ... are our grandparents.

HAR BIR GAPDA egalik shakli yoki egalik sifati ishlatilsin —
mashqning maqsadi shu.

structure.modelEn: Hi! I'm Aziz and I'm twelve.
Rustam and Nilufar are my parents.
Dilnoza is my father's sister. She is my aunt.
Bobur is her husband. He's my uncle.
Their son's name is Jasur. He's ten years old. He's my cousin.
Karim and Zulfiya are our grandparents.
They are Rustam and Dilnoza's parents.

groups.explanationUz: Har bir shaxs uchun ega, obyekt va egalik shakllari bor. Uchalasini birga yodlang.
Bu juftliklar talaffuzda farq qilmaydi — faqat yozuvda. Ma'nolari esa butunlay boshqa.
Egalik sifati OT bilan keladi, egalik olmoshi YOLG'IZ turadi.
Bitta inglizcha so'z bir necha o'zbekcha so'zni qoplaydi.

patterns.formula: X is + EGALIK SHAKLI + qarindoshlik. He/She is + EGALIK SIFATI + qarindoshlik.
patterns.exampleEn: Dave is John and Ann's nephew. He is their nephew.
patterns.exampleUz: Deyv — Jon va Annning jiyani. U ularning jiyani.
patterns.explanationUz: Ikkinchi gap birinchisining qisqartirilgani: ism o'rniga olmosh keladi.

patterns.formula: Who's + ISM? — He's/She's + EGALIK SHAKLI + qarindoshlik.
patterns.explanationUz: Odamning kimligini so'rash. Who's = Who is.

patterns.formula: Whose + ot + is + ISM? — He's/She's + EGALIK SHAKLI + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: Whose son is John? — He's Carol and Bill's son.
patterns.exampleUz: Jon kimning o'g'li? — U Kerol va Billning o'g'li.
patterns.explanationUz: Egasini so'rash. 'Whose' dan keyin DOIM ot keladi.

patterns.formula: Look at + OBYEKT olmoshi. + EGA olmoshi + is/are + ...
patterns.exampleEn: Look at them. They're desks. Look at her. She's Mary.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularga qara. Ular partalar. Unga qara. U Meri.
patterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi gapda obyekt shakli, ikkinchisida ega shakli.
Bu farqni sezmaslik — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

patterns.formula: Is + ISM/he/she + your + qarindoshlik? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Is Tony your father? — No, he isn't. Is he your uncle? — Yes, he is.
patterns.exampleUz: Toni sizning otangizmi? — Yo'q. U sizning amakingizmi? — Ha.
patterns.explanationUz: Ha/yo'q savoli. Qisqa javobda ot takrorlanmaydi.

IKKI BOSQICHLI egalik: THEIR (sifat) + son'S (shakl) + name.
O'zbekchada ham shunday: ular-NING o'g'li-NING ismi.
